svg.title: TinyDoc measured results by tier
svg.desc: Receipt field F1: 3B 94.8 percent, 2B 92.0 percent, first-party hybrid 60.3 percent, OCR baseline 37.6 percent. Invoice key-header: 3B 91.9, 2B 93.5; fully correct: 3B 65.7, 2B 71.8. Multipage: all-pages 4 of 10 fully correct; page-wise 6 of 10 and 93.3 percent key-header. Latency per page: receipts 3B 14.1 seconds, 2B 7.0; invoices 3B 26.5, 2B 16.1.
